mapper.select: SELECT d.driver_contact, d.driver_birthdate, d.driver_lon, d.driver_lat, d.created_at, d.driver_name, d.driver_idx, d.driver_img, a.admin_name, c.car_number, COUNT(l.car_number) AS count_log FROM tb_driver d LEFT JOIN tb_admin a ON d.admin_idx = a.admin_idx LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON d.driver_idx = c.driver_idx LEFT JOIN tb_log l ON l.car_number = c.car_number GROUP BY d.driver_idx, d.driver_contact, d.driver_birthdate, d.driver_lon, d.driver_lat, d.created_at, a.admin_name, c.car_number
SELECT * FROM tb_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT l.*, d.driver_idx FROM tb_log l LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON l.car_number = c.car_number LEFT JOIN tb_driver d ON c.driver_idx = d.driver_idx ORDER BY l.event_level DESC, l.created_at DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_log WHERE YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY event_type
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_log WHERE MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY event_type
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_log WHERE YEARWEEK(created_at, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) GROUP BY event_type
SELECT d.*, c.car_number, c.car_type FROM tb_driver d LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON d.driver_idx = c.driver_idx WHERE admin_idx = #{adminIdx}
